What is SSPilot?

SSPilot is the most advanced Stake automation tool available today. Designed for both casual players and experienced gamblers, it removes emotion from your strategy and streamlines your entire Stake experience by automating original games like Dice, Limbo, Mines, and Plinko, as well as slots from over 31 providers including Pragmatic Play, Hacksaw Gaming, Push Gaming, and NoLimit City.

Unlike basic scripts or browser extensions, SSPilot is a full-featured desktop application built for performance and reliability. Most people lose on Stake because they play emotionally — SSPilot removes that variable. It offers smart betting strategies with customizable parameters, automated bonus hunting that collects and tracks bonuses across hundreds of slot games, and a real-time statistics dashboard with detailed profit tracking and session analytics. The built-in code claimer and reload claimer ensure you never miss a promotion.

You can't beat RNG — but you can beat yourself. SSPilot is free to download and runs locally on your Windows machine. Your Stake API key is stored only on your device, and all connections are encrypted. With weekly bug fixes, monthly feature updates, and a growing community of thousands of active users, SSPilot is the automation tool serious Stake players rely on to execute their strategy with discipline and optimize their sessions.
